assignments.node_id: מתגברין בעזות גדול כנגדם, שזהו עזות דקדשה
assignments.reason: This node describes the act of 'overpowering with great boldness against them, which is holy boldness' — its essential nature IS עזות דקדשה (holy boldness), the defining concept of Package 1. The node explicitly identifies itself as עזות דקדשה in its own text.

assignments.node_id: אנו נותנין כביכול עז וכח למעלה, בבחינת "תנו עז לאלקים"
assignments.reason: This node describes 'we give, as it were, strength and power Above, in the aspect of give strength to God' — its essential nature is the upward-directed giving of holy strength, which is the arousal-from-below (אתערותא דלתתא) that defines Package 1. The node itself references 'תנו עז לאלקים' as its bechina, placing it squarely in the domain of holy boldness rising upward.

This node is 'the holy boldness that is in him' — it is the human possession of עזות דקדשה, the core concept of Package 1. Its essential nature is holy boldness residing in the person, the prerequisite for receiving Torah and standing against opponents.

This node is 'he receives holy boldness from God' — the Divine bestowal of עזות דקדשה back to the person. While this is the Divine response (effect), its essential nature is still עזות דקדשה — holy boldness, the same quality that defines Package 1. The substance received is identical to the substance given; both are expressions of holy boldness. The Rebbe structures this as the same quality cycling between below and above — it belongs in the holy boldness package by nature, not by causal position.

assignments.node_id: נתעורר למעלה בחינת עזות דקדשה, ונשפע עלינו, בבחינת "אל ישראל הוא נותן עז ותעצומות לעם", שהשם יתברך משפיע עלינו עזות דקדשה, ונותן לנו עז ותעצומות, לעמד כנגד העזות דסטרא אחרא של כל העזי פנים שבדור, שאי אפשר לעמד כנגדם, כי־אם על־ידי עזות דקדשה
assignments.reason: This compound node describes the full Divine response: holy boldness is aroused Above and flows down to us as strength and might to stand against the evil boldness of the sitra achra. Despite mentioning the evil side (עזות דסטרא אחרא, עזי פנים), the essential nature of this node is the Divine outpouring of עזות דקדשה — it is the culmination of the holy boldness cycle. The node explicitly names its own bechina as 'אל ישראל הוא נותן עז ותעצומות לעם' and repeatedly identifies its substance as עזות דקדשה. It belongs in Package 1 by essential nature.
